title: Sony PlayStation 5 Console
shortDescription: Next-generation gaming console with ultra-high-speed SSD
description: Experience lightning-fast loading with an ultra-high speed SSD, deeper immersion with support for haptic feedback, adaptive triggers, and 3D Audio, and an all-new generation of incredible PlayStation games. The PS5 console unleashes new gaming possibilities that you never anticipated.

title: Apple MacBook Air M2
shortDescription: Ultra-thin laptop with Apple M2 chip and 13.6-inch display
description: The redesigned MacBook Air is more portable than ever and weighs just 1.24 kg. It's the incredibly capable laptop that lets you work, play, or create just about anything — anywhere. Apple M2 chip brings more speed and power efficiency. 13.6-inch Liquid Retina display with up to 500 nits of brightness. 1080p FaceTime HD camera. MagSafe charging port. Two Thunderbolt ports.

title: Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra 5G
shortDescription: Flagship smartphone with 200MP camera and S Pen
description: Meet Galaxy AI on the new Galaxy S24 Ultra. The new ProVisual engine recognizes objects, enhances details and reduces noise in photos. Zoom into crystal clear details or adjust image preferences while staying true to the original. 200MP camera with Nightography features. Dynamic AMOLED 2X display with 6.8-inch screen. Built-in S Pen for productivity. 5000mAh battery with fast charging.

title: Sony WH-1000XM5 Headphones
description: Industry-leading noise cancellation with Auto NC Optimizer. Crystal clear hands-free calling with 4 beamforming microphones and advanced audio signal processing. Up to 30-hour battery life with quick charging. Multi-point connection allows you to switch between devices. Speak-to-Chat and Quick Attention mode. Premium sound quality with LDAC and DSEE Extreme.

title: Dell XPS 15 Laptop
description: Experience brilliant visuals on a stunning 15.6-inch OLED display with 3.5K resolution. Powered by 13th Gen Intel Core i7 processor and NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4050 graphics. 16GB DDR5 RAM and 512GB NVMe SSD for lightning-fast performance. Premium aluminum and carbon fiber build. Thunderbolt 4 ports for versatile connectivity.
